summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, furnishing the final detailed voting map from its Extraordinary General Meeting held the same day. The filing is a post-meeting disclosure under CVM Resolution 81/22, showing how shareholders voted on six items. No special situation event is present—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. This is a routine regulatory report of meeting results and does not constitute a special situation.
